summary: Full end-to-end validation of the 'Saved Pros' feature (backend + frontend) plus rebrand smoke. 13/13 pytest backend cases PASS covering all 3 CRUD endpoints, idempotency, ordering, is_saved on both /providers/search and /providers/{id}, 404 (non-existent) and 400 (self-save) edge cases, and 401 unauth. Frontend Playwright walkthrough as a customer PASS: heart toggle on /find-providers persists across reload (aria-pressed true + rose class), Save Pro <-> Saved label toggles on /providers/:id and persists, /saved-providers page renders the saved-provider-card with correct count and unsave button, and empty state with browse button renders after last unsave. Sidebar visibility across all 5 roles matched spec: customer (Explore) / landlord / property / facilities show 'Saved Pros'; provider and insurance do NOT. No 'Dispatchr' text visible in user-facing UI; 'Pro Finder NZ' brand rendered. No backend or frontend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_saved_providers issues 2 sequential Mongo queries (profiles + users) plus a saved_at map — fine for the 200-item cap, but if the cap grows consider a single aggregation pipeline to avoid N+1 growth.
server.py provider_profile always fires an extra find_one on saved_providers even for providers viewing their own or other roles that will never see the Save Pro button — micro-optimisation only.

FindProviders ProviderCard: heart button sits inside a clickable card wrapper — code correctly uses stopPropagation on click, but note there is no aria-label update to reflect the optimistic state until server round-trip completes (currently uses p.is_saved which is updated optimistically, so this is actually fine — noted as verified).
test_credentials: Ephemeral: qa-saved-{role}-{ts}@dispatchr.demo / testpass123, roles: customer, provider, insurance, landlord, property, facilities
context_for_next_testing_agent: Saved Pros feature is ship-ready. Backend endpoints: GET/POST/DELETE /api/saved-providers[/id], idempotent, 404/400/401 semantics correct, is_saved surfaced on both /providers/search and /providers/{id}. Frontend testids stable: save-toggle-{id}, provider-save-btn, saved-providers-page, saved-providers-count, saved-provider-card-{id}, unsave-provider-{id}, saved-providers-empty, saved-providers-browse-btn. Sidebar: customer (Explore), landlord/property/facilities (Actions). Provider + Insurance intentionally excluded.
